summary: Add Amazon as an optional shared external commerce connector, surfaced first in EKODI Mall at /ekodimall/admin/amazon without introducing a new EKODI subdomain.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly approved the proposed Amazon integration architecture and instructed EKODI to carry it through subordinate pages and services under the forced-execution rules.
migrationPlan: Add a shared Amazon connector boundary to the Mall API, expose tenant-scoped readiness in the existing Mall administrator shell, and keep live Selling Partner API mutations disabled until credentials and production verification are complete.
securityModel: Amazon credentials remain server-side only; the browser receives readiness metadata but never secrets. Tenant authorization remains Person + Workspace + Role + Capability. Live external mutations fail closed until explicit credentials and a verified SP-API execution adapter are enabled.
rollback: Remove the Amazon route from Mall navigation and API entry routing while retaining no Amazon credentials or user-visible dependency in the platform.
verificationPolicy: Run repository syntax/tests, Mall navigation and connector contract tests, guarded staging/release, and production verification of /ekodimall/admin/amazon before enabling live synchronization.
